description: Regression proof for implementation task 6, Part A (loud failure for a partially-read simulation file when read_event_weights is enabled): FileParser._parse_opened_file run on real files, once with feature/cms-mc-weights-and-probe-retry (3cf6ffd21d685316a1893620716c51bfc024b8e1) and once with feature/hgg-selection-and-output, read_event_weights left at its default (False) in both, so the new behaviour is never triggered. Same 4 CMS files and 1 ATLAS file as every earlier task's own regression proof, at most 2,000 events per file.
note: None of these 5 real files ever produce a PartialFileReadError under a normal read (confirmed across every earlier task's regression run too), so Part A's new code path (in ThreadedFileProcessor.process_files) was structurally never reached during this check regardless of the read_event_weights flag; the default-False setting additionally guarantees it even if a partial read had occurred. This regression proof establishes that Part A's changes introduce zero behaviour difference for every existing configuration's normal operation.
transient_network_failures_during_this_c: 30529 (feature branch): one transient EventIds-probe failure on the first attempt, succeeded on retry against the identical file.
30530 (feature branch): one transient HTTP 429 on the first attempt, succeeded on retry.
ATLAS file (feature branch): one transient rucio read failure on the first attempt, succeeded on the second retry.
All consistent with the ordinary remote-storage flakiness seen throughout this project; the base branch's dumps of the identical files all succeeded on their first attempt.
overall_verdict: IDENTICAL for all 4 CMS datasets and one real ATLAS file.
